note: Typed one line per press, in order, shared by every typewriter in a run. An earlier wanderer's account.
lines: day one. the lift doors opened on a floor that is not in the directory.
i am writing this down because the carpet keeps changing colour when i am not looking at it.
there is a typewriter on every third desk. somebody wanted us to keep records.
the lights buzz louder where it has been. the quiet rooms are worse.
i saw it once. it was standing very still at the end of a corridor. it stayed still for as long as i looked.
i blinked. it was closer. i did not blink again for a long time.
the wall maps are wrong. not all of them. enough of them.
i tied red string to a radiator. the string goes on for a long way. i did not tie all of it.
found a badge with my name on it. the photo was not me. the photo was not finished.
the vending machines still take coins. i do not know who empties them.
if you are reading this you came in the same way. keep the torch charged.
i recorded myself breathing and left it playing in a room i did not need. it went to the room.
the hum is not the lights. the hum is the building. it is counting.
i am going to stop typing now. it is right behind the paper.
